fmiModelDescription.description: Signal-based FMU - Stellantis LRCF FD-CAN15 (JOB3_Entry_LRCF_FD_CAN15_ver7). CAN: inputs VCAN_RX.<Msg>.<Signal> from ZCU_F/ZCU_CL; outputs VCAN_TX.<Msg>.<Signal> from LRCF perception. Ethernet: lo/hi pointer-triplet, 1 frame/step (EthRxIn VR 5000-5002, EthTxOut VR 5003-5005). Required step size: 1 ms (1000 Hz). Config parameters VR 100-115: ETH IP/port hint + sensor position/orientation.
